comparisons.name: search-light
comparisons.description: The whole window of the Aqua Preview-Search capture, 1147 x 793 pt: a word in the focused search field, the find bar, the seven pages found in the sidebar and the first of them from its top. Whole crop: the booklet is the demo's own, so the title, the word searched for, the file's name, every row of the sidebar and every text of the pages differ from the capture's; the banner of the page is an abstract placeholder where the capture has a photograph, and it and the page miniatures of the sidebar, which are artwork, are masked; the glyphs are stand-in drawings; and the text is set in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: search-light-layout
comparisons.description: As search-light with the text and the stand-in artwork masked (the title with its icon; the glyphs of the seven toolbar items and the content of the search field; in the find bar the label with the two scopes, whose pill is as wide as its text, the found count and Done; the file's name; in each of the seven rows the thumbnail, the page's name, the count and the words found; on the page the banner, the two columns of text and the page number), to score the frame, the title bar and every toolbar bezel with the search field's focus ring, the find bar's surface with its arrows and its Done bezel, the sidebar's surface, the selected row and the lines between the rows, the divider, the canvas, and the paper of the pages with the gaps between them. The View button is the library's toolbar pull-down, 47 pt wide where Preview's is 36 pt, so the zoom pair and the Share button sit 11 pt right of the capture's; each of their masks runs from the glyph in the capture to the glyph here, and their displaced bezels are in the score.

comparisons.name: search-dark
comparisons.description: The whole window of the Dark Aqua Preview-Search capture, 1376 x 822 pt, scrolled as captured: the end of the first page found and the page after it. Whole crop: the booklet is the demo's own, so the title, the word searched for, the file's name, every row of the sidebar and every text of the pages differ from the capture's; the banner of the page is an abstract placeholder where the capture has a photograph, and it and the page miniatures of the sidebar, which are artwork, are masked; the glyphs are stand-in drawings; and the text is set in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: search-dark-layout
comparisons.description: As search-dark with the text and the stand-in artwork masked (the title with its icon; the glyphs of the seven toolbar items and the content of the search field; in the find bar the label with the two scopes, whose pill is as wide as its text, the found count and Done; the file's name; in each of the seven rows the thumbnail, the page's name, the count and the words found; on the two pages the text and the page number), and with the bars masked from 125 pt on: the captured window is vibrant, and in Dark Aqua the white paper behind its bars lightens them from the sidebar's edge on, which a page cannot reproduce. This scores the frame, the window controls and the start of the bars, the sidebar's surface, the selected row and the lines between the rows, the divider, the canvas, and the paper of the pages with the gap between them; the toolbar's bezels in Dark Aqua are scored by desktop-dark-layout.

comparisons.name: desktop-light
comparisons.description: The top 64 pt of the Aqua Preview capture, a 899 pt wide window that shows a picture: the title bar with the toolbar, its Highlight button unavailable and its search field empty. The capture's picture is a desktop picture, which is not reproduced and covers more of the window than a comparison may mask, so only this strip is compared; the 9 pt of the demo's placeholder picture in it are masked. The glyphs are stand-in drawings and the text is set in the fallback font.

comparisons.description: As desktop-light with the title and its icon, the glyphs of the seven toolbar items and the content of the search field masked too, to score the frame's top corners, the window controls, the title bar's surface and lower edge, and every toolbar bezel. The View button is the library's toolbar pull-down, 47 pt wide where Preview's is 36 pt, so the zoom pair and the Share button sit 11 pt right of the capture's; each of their masks runs from the glyph in the capture to the glyph here, and their displaced bezels are in the score.

comparisons.name: choose-found-page-light
comparisons.description: Choosing a page in the sidebar switches to it, in the browser: with the pages found listed and page 9 shown, a click on the row of page 13 selects that row and brings a page without a banner to the top of the view. Which page it is cannot be read from pixels: preview.browser.test.tsx reads the title, the selected row and the page's place from the same window in Chromium. No screenshot shows the moment after a click.

pixels.note: the top-left corner of the page in view is paper (--mac-preview-paper, measured): page 13 has no banner, where page 9 has its banner here
the same further along the top of the page
the row of page 9 is no longer selected: the sidebar's surface (--mac-preview-sidebar, measured), where the selected row is --mac-preview-row-selected
the second row, page 13's, is the selected one, and emphasised because the click gave the list the keyboard focus: --mac-color-selected-content-background for the blue accent (shared token)
the page in view starts 4 pt under the find bar: above it is the canvas (--mac-preview-canvas, measured)
and from 4 pt under the bar it is paper: the page was brought to the top, not to somewhere inside it
